title: taco-rdf: the Brazilian Food Composition Table (TACO) as an RDF knowledge graph
description:
The Brazilian Food Composition Table (TACO, 4th edition, NEPA-UNICAMP 2011) as an RDF knowledge graph: 597 foods in 15 groups with 21,150 nutrient measurements, typed with FoodOn and the Food Item Ontology, aligned to ChEBI, CDNO and QUDT, validated with SHACL, with PROV-O provenance and an ODRL attribution policy.

Persistent IRIs: https://w3id.org/taco-rdf/. Graph, vocabulary, shapes and alignments under CC BY 4.0; code under MIT. The nutrient values come from TACO, whose terms allow total or partial reproduction provided the source is cited.
references: NEPA-UNICAMP. Tabela brasileira de composição de alimentos - TACO. 4. ed. rev. e ampl. Campinas: NEPA-UNICAMP, 2011.
